description: Ragdoll codex pet — 9-state animated video-extracted spritesheet.

identity.silhouetteNotes: compact full-body ragdoll, readable at 64x64, scale-consistent across states

provenance.pipeline: mother-image → AI video (operator manual) → ffmpeg 4fps → center-crop → border-connected white-background flood-fill → resize → 128-color palette → lossless WebP
tasteWatchItems: Video-extracted frames have organic movement vs AI-generated pixel art
White fur requires border-connected background removal; global color-key transparency is forbidden
Idle frames must preserve one fixed video crop and scale; per-frame trim/fit creates visible size popping

qa.scaleConsistencyCheck: pass (idle visible-height spread 9px; ground-line spread 5px; fixed-crop scale preserved)
qa.alphaMaskIntegrityCheck: pass (57 manifest-declared frames; no frame exceeds 300 enclosed transparent pixels)
qa.darkBackgroundCheck: pass (white muzzle, chest, and paws remain opaque at atlas and 59x64 display sizes)
qa.displayCompressionCheck: pass (palette-optimized lossless WebP checked at 59x64 default and 169px maximum production display sizes)
qa.idleMotionPreviewCheck: pass (no unintended size popping at production display size)
